主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. announced that Chairman and CEO James A. Luksch will retire and resign from his positions effective March 26, 2015. His decision is not due to any dispute with the company. A letter agreement was signed on March 24, 2015, outlining his separation terms. His employment and directorship will end on March 26, 2015, with continued base salary and benefits until that date. Health benefits will remain active until April 30, 2015. All outstanding stock options will vest and be exercisable for 90 days after his Last Day, after which they expire. The letter agreement also includes a deferred compensation amount of $166,667 and a voting agreement where Luksch will vote his shares in line with the board's recommendations, with an irrevocable proxy to designated officers and directors until June 30, 2018.
